'''SL33-Z''' was a sales droid who was sent by [[Ma'Haffee Shipyard]] to represent them at the [[Cularin Trade Show]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

He was of a very rare design and consisted of a large immobile computer station that controlled eight humanoid droid salesmen drones. These drones resembled [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, but with display screens on their heads. They escorted customers around the showroom to show them the company's products and SL33-Z was programmed to make them use a hard-sell appoach to these interactions.
